allowLeadingZeros.name: Allow leading zeros
allowLeadingZeros.hint: This allows enabling or disabling leading zeros in the input field. By default, on blur of an input, leading zeros are removed

allowNegative.name: Allow negative
allowNegative.hint: If set to false, negative numbers will not be allowed

allowedDecimalSeparators.name: Allowed decimal separators
allowedDecimalSeparators.hint: Characters which when pressed result in a decimal separator. When missing, decimal separator and '.' are used

decimalScale.name: Decimal scale
decimalScale.hint: If defined, it limits the number of digits after the decimal point

fixedDecimalScale.name: Fixed decimal scale
fixedDecimalScale.hint: If set to true, it adds trailing 0s after decimalSeparator to match given decimalScale

prefix.name: Prefix
prefix.hint: Adds the prefix character before the input value

suffix.name: Suffix
suffix.hint: Adds the suffix after the input value

thousandsGroupStyle.name: Thousands group style
thousandsGroupStyle.hint: Thousand style (thousand) : 123,456,789, indian style (lakh) : 12,34,56,789, chinese style (wan) : 1,2345,6789

allowEmptyFormatting.name: Allow empty formatting
allowEmptyFormatting.hint: By default PatternFormat component does not apply formatting when value is empty (null, undefined or ‘’)

format.name: Format
format.hint: Format pattern using the # (or a Pattern char) character. # is the placeholder character for numbers. Example: '### ###'

mask.name: Mask
mask.hint: Used as mask character for numeric places, until any numeric character is provided for that position

patternChar.name: Pattern char
patternChar.hint: This helps define the format pattern character

eventKey.name: Event key
eventKey.hint: The event key corresponding to this element

accept.name: Accept
accept.hint: File types that can be accepted. See standard HTML attribute: accept

autoUpload.name: Auto upload
autoUpload.hint: Automatically upload files after selecting them

disableMultipart.name: Disable multipart
disableMultipart.hint: If 'true', disable using a multipart form for file upload and instead stream the file. Some APIs (e.g. Amazon S3) may expect the file to be streamed rather than sent via a form

draggable.name: Draggable
draggable.hint: Enabled drag and drop to upload

method.name: Method
method.hint: The http method of upload request

name.name: Name
name.hint: Upload the parameter name of the corresponding file

withCredentials.name: With credentials
withCredentials.hint: Whether to carry cookies when uploading requests

leftMenu.currentFormName: The name of the current form
leftMenu.formSaveError: Failed to save form! See the logs in the browser console
leftMenu.exportFormsError: Failed to export forms! See the logs in the browser console
leftMenu.importFormsError: Failed to import forms! See the logs in the browser console

propertiesEditor.selectElementForEdit: Select element on form for edit properties
